stem: Which of these best describes the author's purpose for writing this article?

options.label: F
options.text: To criticize the failure of linguists to document a language before it was nearly extinct

options.label: G
options.text: To analyze the linguistic elements of one of the oldest and most pure Inuit dialects

options.label: H
options.text: To inform the public of a researcher's effort to document a disappearing language

options.label: J
options.text: To argue that the Inuktun dialect will inevitably be lost in the next 10 to 15 years
